# Hand-applied specified mutation: always emit all units.
def format_duration(seconds):
    if seconds < 0:
        raise ValueError("seconds must be non-negative")
    if seconds == 0:
        return "0s"
    parts = []
    days, rem = divmod(seconds, 86400)
    hours, rem = divmod(rem, 3600)
    minutes, secs = divmod(rem, 60)
    parts.append(f"{days}d")
    parts.append(f"{hours}h")
    parts.append(f"{minutes}m")
    parts.append(f"{secs}s")
    return " ".join(parts)

Formula: denominator = 1 + z*z/n; centre = (p + z*z/(2*n)) / denominator where p = k/n; delta = z*sqrt(p*(1-p)/n + z*z/(4*n*n)) / denominator; lower = centre - delta, clamped to [0, 1]. Tests must cover: k=0,n=10 (lower is 0.0); k=n=10 (lower approx 0.72); k=5,n=10 (lower approx 0.24); n=0 returns 0.0; k>n raises ValueError; k<0 raises ValueError.
